title: Custom Software Development
shortDescription: Tailored software solutions designed to solve your unique business challenges.
fullDescription: At Crackit, we build custom software applications that drive efficiency and growth. Whether you need an internal enterprise tool, a customer-facing web application, or a complex API integration, our team of expert developers uses the latest technologies to deliver robust, scalable, and secure software.
fullDescriptionSecondary: We follow agile methodologies, ensuring you are involved at every stage of the development process. From initial concept and architecture design to coding, testing, and deployment, we focus on delivering high-quality code that meets your exact requirements.

whatWeProvide.title:
Web
Applications
whatWeProvide.description: Scalable web platforms using modern frameworks.

challengeText: Many businesses struggle with off-the-shelf software that doesn't quite fit their processes. This leads to inefficiencies, workarounds, and data silos.

faqs.question: What technologies do you use?
faqs.answer: We use modern stacks including Vue.js, React, Node.js, Python, and scalable databases like PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Project timelines vary depending on complexity, but most initial MVPs can be launched within 2 to 3 months.

faqs.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer ongoing maintenance and support contracts to ensure your software remains up-to-date and secure.

title: Mobile App Development
shortDescription: Engaging iOS and Android applications for your users on the go.
fullDescription: We design and develop high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android. Whether you need a native app or a cross-platform solution using React Native or Flutter, our mobile development team ensures a seamless and intuitive user experience.
fullDescriptionSecondary: Our mobile solutions are built with scalability and performance in mind, ensuring your app can handle high traffic and complex interactions. We also assist with App Store and Google Play submissions.
challengeText: In today's mobile-first world, lacking a dedicated app can mean missing out on significant user engagement and revenue opportunities.

faqs.question: Do you build native or cross-platform?
faqs.answer: We build both! We will recommend the best approach based on your budget, timeline, and feature requirements.

faqs.question: Will you help upload it to the app stores?
faqs.answer: Absolutely, we handle the entire submission process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

faqs.question: Can you integrate with my existing backend?
faqs.answer: Yes, our mobile apps can seamlessly connect to any REST or GraphQL API you currently have.

title: UI/UX Design
shortDescription: Beautiful, intuitive interfaces that your users will love.
fullDescription: Our design process puts the user first. We create wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that look stunning and provide an effortless user experience. Good design is not just about aesthetics; it's about solving user problems efficiently.
fullDescriptionSecondary: We conduct user research, usability testing, and create comprehensive design systems to ensure consistency across all your digital products.
challengeText: Complex interfaces frustrate users, leading to high bounce rates and low conversion. A poor UI can ruin even the best underlying technology.

faqs.question: What design tools do you use?
faqs.answer: We primarily use Figma for all our UI/UX design and prototyping work.

faqs.question: Do you do user testing?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer user testing services to validate our designs before they go into development.

faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing app?
faqs.answer: Definitely. We often audit and redesign existing applications to improve their usability and modern appeal.

title: Cloud & DevOps
shortDescription: Scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure.
fullDescription: We help businesses migrate to the cloud and optimize their existing infrastructure. Our DevOps experts implement CI/CD pipelines, containerization with Docker and Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code to ensure your applications are always available and easily scalable.
fullDescriptionSecondary: Whether you are on AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, we ensure your infrastructure is secure, cost-effective, and highly performant.
challengeText: Managing servers manually is slow, error-prone, and doesn't scale. Downtime can cost your business heavily.

faqs.question: Which cloud providers do you support?
faqs.answer: We work with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure.

faqs.question: What is CI/CD?
faqs.answer: Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment automate the process of testing and releasing code, reducing errors and saving time.

faqs.question: Can you audit our current setup?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide comprehensive cloud architecture audits to identify security flaws and cost-saving opportunities.

title: IT Consulting
shortDescription: Strategic technology guidance to accelerate your digital transformation.
fullDescription: Navigating the digital landscape can be daunting. Our IT consulting services provide you with a clear roadmap for adopting new technologies, improving operational efficiency, and achieving your business goals through digital innovation.
fullDescriptionSecondary: From assessing your current tech stack to recommending modern solutions, our experts act as your fractional CTOs to guide your tech strategy.
challengeText: Investing in the wrong technology can be a costly mistake. Without a clear tech strategy, businesses often fall behind their competitors.

faqs.question: Do you offer fractional CTO services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can provide high-level technical leadership on a part-time basis for your startup or enterprise.

faqs.question: How do you conduct an audit?
faqs.answer: We analyze your codebase, infrastructure, security practices, and team workflows to provide a detailed report.

faqs.question: Can you help us hire tech talent?
faqs.answer: Yes, we assist in technical interviews and assessing the skills of potential hires for your team.

title: API & Integrations
shortDescription: Connecting your disparate systems into a unified workflow.
fullDescription: Modern businesses rely on multiple SaaS tools and platforms. We build custom APIs and integrations to make your systems talk to each other, automating workflows and eliminating manual data entry.
fullDescriptionSecondary: Whether integrating payment gateways like M-Pesa and Stripe, or connecting your CRM to your ERP, we ensure smooth and secure data flow.
challengeText: Data silos prevent businesses from getting a clear picture of their operations. Manual data transfer between systems is slow and prone to errors.

faqs.question: Can you integrate M-Pesa?
faqs.answer: Yes, being based in Kenya, M-Pesa integration (C2B, B2C, B2B) is one of our core specialties.

faqs.question: Do you build REST or GraphQL APIs?
faqs.answer: We build both, depending on the specific needs and complexity of the data required by your client applications.

faqs.question: Are the integrations secure?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We implement industry-standard authentication (OAuth2, JWT) and encryption protocols to protect your data.
